decisions.reason: The compact trommel screen has its own page and the firm reports early market acceptance, and it extends the firm's core screening line, so management will keep investing in it.

A newly launched multi-model flail shredder line with a dedicated page represents substantial development investment and visible commitment, so management will persist despite the lack of reported results.
The high-speed grinder line is only mentioned, but its multi-model investment and fit with the announced portfolio expansion lead management to attribute any slow uptake to the early market phase.
The single stationary electric fine shredder has low visibility, yet it fits the resource-saving direction and only launched a year ago, so management keeps it for now.
The green-waste grinder line overlaps with Product C, but the investment already made and the firm's established position in composting customers argue for persistence.
The stationary pre-shredder line has its own page and supports the firm's push into plant-based solutions, so the sunk costs and public commitment favour keeping it.
